AirBnB Offer Received | Interview Experience | Waiting on team match
I got the call from the recruiter that I passed the core value round and have entered team match phase. I've heard AirBnB team match can take super long sometimes even 6 months, but I'm ready to get out of my current job, so praying this goes quick. AirBnB is a perfect fit for me, since being remote friendly would let me travel back home more often. In the meantime I figured I could share what helped me prep for AirBnB's interview rounds.

The coding rounds are super heavy on DP. I'm shocked that how many DP questions they ask since most other companies don't ask DP questions. And this is an area I was weak on so I focused a lot of my prep work on getting good at the DP basics and being able to implement it quickly. There's good resources for practicing questions by topics in posts like this: https://leetcode.com/discuss/post/7333827/the-pattern-based-approach-to-mastering-uwgbd

The interview process started with a phone screen which was a DP question that asked me to find the most cost effective menu order. I was expecting DP for any round and had already seen this problem on offerretriever during prepping, so this went as well as it could and I moved on. 

The onsite coding round I was asked to find the best way for a group to split their stay in a neighborhood. I had seen this question before in the discussion section here. I didn't think the interviewer liked my solution, and he kept poking to see if I could describe a more optimized solution instead. I ended up only having enough time to code the suboptimal solution which passed all the test cases, and I could only describe a few potential ways to optimize it. I thought I may be in trouble after that, but luckily the interviewer still gave me a pass. I guess passing all the test cases was the important part.
